written: 2026-10-06, WP6 fix round 1, AFTER S1 results: it lists only which R2 / R3 computations READ each S1 quantity (a fact of the code), never how much an error matters. The S1 runs it was written after gave theta 3.43 deg (the S1 before the lambert-1 photos) and 4.12 deg (the lambert-1 S1 on record at the end of fix round 1), each the maximum over every observed (view, side), and outline 0.206 mm vs 0.2. Fix round 2 (2026-10-06) added theta_pairs: the (view, side) pairs whose fitted theta R2 / R3 read, on which S1 now grades theta (in the lambert-1 S1: 05+x 2.96, 01-x 2.51, 02+x 1.22 deg). Whether a failure that R2 / R3 read may be waived is the owner's decision, not the implementer's. Schema 3 (2026-10-07, fit-4, written BEFORE the fit-4 S1 ran): R2 reads no hinge angle. A side view fits no theta (relief_views.SIDE_THETA_WHY: WP6_DESIGN section 6 scores theta on the 02 / 03 / 06 / 04 arm rows; a side view sees a hinge rotation only as an image tilt its camera roll reproduces), so wp6_prada_stages.stage_gates renders 05 / 01 for R2 with theta 0 and lifts segments with theta 0. R3 still reads the 02 theta of the +X temple (relief_fit.transfer_all lifts the 05 line at theta 0 and projects it into 02 at the fitted 02 camera and theta): theta_pairs is now R3: 02+x only, and S1 grades it in a COMMON camera frame (wp6_theta_frame.apparent_theta), because a theta relative to a fitted camera that trades with it (02: yaw) is no recovery measure. S1 also runs an instrument floor (R2 / R3 of the TRUE temple and of a slab at the fitted cameras; STOP-I when it fails). f1_rise exists only in the F1 topology (the pyramid has no F1).
rule: WP6_DESIGN section 8 S1 and section 9 STOP-I: an S1 recovery outside its tolerance (relief_rules.S1_RECOVERY) that R2 or R3 reads is STOP-I, unless the owner waives it (tests/proofs/wp6_prada.py --owner-waiver KEY=TEXT, recorded in proof.json as 'STOP-I waived by owner'). A failure nothing in R2 / R3 reads is recorded as an S1 failure. A quantity S1 cannot test (not a free parameter of the fit) is recorded as 'not fitted' with who reads it. UNOBSERVED (keep the default, section 12) applies only to a fitted parameter with a default; it is never used for S1 failures. tests/proofs/wp6_prada.py --resume refuses a run whose recorded table sha256 differs from this file's.
